description: This file contains a Smarty plugin function 'html_table' used to generate HTML tables from data arrays, including support for customization of table attributes, layout, and appearance.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_table
methods.description: Generates an HTML table from input array data with various customizable options like number of columns, rows, and styling attributes.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_table_cycle
methods.description: Cycles through attribute arrays for table elements to apply styles or attributes in a pattern.
